text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

The panel's composition can't plausibly explain this outcome: you and the person appointed are both women, so sex offers no mechanism for favouring her over you. An all-women panel is also unremarkable in policy roles, where women are well represented. Raising it would read as grievance-driven and undercut your credibility on the point that actually has weight.

The real issue is procedural: two weeks' silence on a written explanation request. Chase it in writing, cite any applicable recruitment or freedom-of-information rules, and ask specifically how "experience of leading international projects" was weighted and scored against the published criteria. If that criterion wasn't in the advertised requirements, that's your genuine concern — pursue it.
